recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce Claim.diagnosis.packageCode for FHIR-11371; any future structural DRG change should come from FHIR-26712 or another final work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11371 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Financial Management change request for Claim asking to rename the drg attribute in Claim.diagnosis to packageCode.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11371 was found. Git history shows d06f8787e65d9eb23bd903d44c86c650b2fac541 changed the historical spreadsheet source from Claim.diagnosis.drg to Claim.diagnosis.packageCode and revised the wording to package billing code language, which appears to be the original application.
additional_context: FHIR-11370 is the paired Claim tracker for choosing a consistent package-code term. Later Published issue FHIR-29688 required diagnosisRelatedGroup 0..1 CodeableConcept at the Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit roots and removal of resource.diagnosis.packageCode. The current build-scope Claim source follows that later decision. FHIR-26712 remains Triaged/Unresolved and is background only.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Claim, source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml defines Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup at the root, and verification found no current Claim.diagnosis.drg or Claim.diagnosis.packageCode element.

related_jiras.note: Paired Claim tracker for selecting a consistent package-code term; it resolved with the same packageCode rename.
Final R5 decision to add root diagnosisRelatedGroup to Claim, ClaimResponse, and EOB and remove resource.diagnosis.packageCode.
